title: Add bounded agency fee reconciliation workspace
description: Add a bounded read-only agency service-fee reconciliation and aging workspace over ERP-070 statements and ERP-071 explicit receipt allocations. Derive only arithmetic evidence supported by persisted dates, optional due dates and active allocations. Do not create a general ledger, invent due dates, contact customers, collect funds, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace lists recorded agency service-fee statements and active explicit receipt allocations without copying source rows or creating another agreement, statement, receipt or allocation master.

Users can apply bounded or paged filters for Customer, agreement or statement identity, service source, statement-date range, explicit due-date range, currency, statement status and allocation state using persisted fields only.

For each recorded statement, arithmetic remaining evidence equals statement amount minus active ERP-071 allocations, with over-allocation prevented by source rules and voided allocations excluded but available in explicit history.

Aging is calculated only when an explicit persisted due date exists, against an explicit as-of date, using documented mutually exclusive buckets; statements without due dates remain in a separate unknown-due-date group.
Different currencies are grouped separately and are never combined, converted or presented as one total without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to source evidence.

Draft or voided statements are separately labeled and excluded from active reconciliation totals; missing, invalid or unavailable source links remain visible as unknown or invalid and are not repaired or reassigned.

The workspace distinguishes statement amount evidence, explicit allocated-receipt evidence and arithmetic remainder and states that these are repository reconciliation figures, not a general-ledger balance, audited Customer statement, payment demand, revenue recognition, tax filing or settlement confirmation.

Opening agreement, statement, allocation or receipt detail revalidates existing authentication and module authorization and fails closed when an authoritative source is deleted, unavailable or no longer authorized.

List and aggregate queries are bounded, avoid per-row database access, do not call external services and keep legacy Customers with no agency evidence readable without request-time or production backfill.
The workspace is read-only and does not change Customers, agreements, statements, allocations, service sources, receipts, invoices, balances, tax, finance or settlement records.
Any export uses the same filtered, currency-separated and unknown-due-date semantics as the screen and contains no hidden cross-currency total, concealed fee field or inferred legal assertion.

Unit and integration tests cover explicit and missing due dates, aging boundaries, partial and full allocations, void history, multiple Customers and currencies, as-of filtering, bounded queries, authorization failure and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is deferred during development.

scenarios: Open the agency fee reconciliation workspace for recorded statements with explicit due dates and partial receipt allocations, select an as-of date, and verify currency-separated remaining evidence and documented aging buckets.

Inspect draft, voided, missing-due-date, invalid-link and multi-currency evidence and verify unknown values remain separate, no cross-currency total or concealed fee is shown and no source record is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only arithmetic over repository evidence and non-production validation only. Customer contact, real collection, accounting or tax action, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
